# WebNotePad – Free Online Notepad, Productivity Tools & Games

> A clean, privacy-first suite of free browser-based tools. No sign-up, no downloads, no accounts. Everything runs client-side with local storage. Data never leaves your device.

Website: https://webnotepad.github.io  
Source: https://github.com/webnotepad/webnotepad.github.io

## Core Writing Apps

- [Notepad Online](https://webnotepad.github.io/) – Rich-text editor with instant auto-save, multiple notes, dark mode, find & replace, export to TXT/HTML, live stats, fullscreen, offline support.
- [Diary](https://webnotepad.github.io/diary) – Private daily journal with dated entries and rich text.
- [Focus Writer](https://webnotepad.github.io/focus-writer) – Minimalist zen writing mode with real-time word count.
- [Memo Notepad](https://webnotepad.github.io/memo-notepad) – Quick sticky notes, to-dos and short memos.
- [WordPad Online](https://webnotepad.github.io/wordpad) – Classic-style rich text editor.
- [Markdown Editor](https://webnotepad.github.io/markdown-editor) – Live Markdown preview and editing.
- [Meeting Notes](https://webnotepad.github.io/meeting-notes) – Structured notes for meetings and action items.
- [Teleprompter](https://webnotepad.github.io/teleprompter) – Script reader with adjustable speed and font size.
- [Bionic Reader](https://webnotepad.github.io/bionic-reader) – Convert text into bionic reading format for faster comprehension.
- [Reading List](https://webnotepad.github.io/reading-list) – Track books and articles you want to read.

## Text Analysis & Manipulation

- [Case Converter](https://webnotepad.github.io/case-converter) – Uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, and more.
- [Word Counter](https://webnotepad.github.io/word-counter) – Words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time.
- [Readability Analyzer](https://webnotepad.github.io/readability) – Reading ease, grade level and complexity scores.
- [Word Shuffler](https://webnotepad.github.io/word-shuffler) – Randomize word order for creative prompts.
- [Special Character Converter](https://webnotepad.github.io/special-character-converter) – Convert special / accented characters.
- [Text Diff](https://webnotepad.github.io/text-diff) – Compare two texts and highlight differences.
- [Typing Test](https://webnotepad.github.io/typing-test) – Measure typing speed (WPM) and accuracy.

## Idea Organization & Visualization

- [MindMap](https://webnotepad.github.io/mindmap) – Interactive mind-mapping board for brainstorming.
- [List Maker](https://webnotepad.github.io/list-maker) – Checklists, to-dos and bullet lists with drag-and-drop.
- [Study Planner](https://webnotepad.github.io/study-planner) – Plan study sessions, assignments and exam prep.

## Creativity & Generators

- [Random Text Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/random-text) – Placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words.
- [Word Cloud Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/word-cloud) – Visual word clouds with customizable colors and fonts.
- [Choice Maker / Decision Wheel](https://webnotepad.github.io/choice-maker) – Spin a wheel, flip a coin or randomize options.
- [Random Name Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/random-name-generator) – Generate names for characters, projects, etc.
- [Password Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/password-generator) – Strong random passwords with customizable options.
- [QR Code Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/qr-code-generator) – Create QR codes from any text or URL.
- [Emoji Picker](https://webnotepad.github.io/emoji-picker) – Search, browse and copy emojis.
- [Business Card Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/business-card-generator) – Design simple digital business cards.
- [Invoice Generator](https://webnotepad.github.io/invoice-generator) – Create professional invoices in the browser.
- [Resume Builder](https://webnotepad.github.io/resume-builder) – Build and export a clean resume.

## Word & Puzzle Helpers

- [Word Finder](https://webnotepad.github.io/word-finder) – Anagrams, word search helpers and vocabulary tools.
- [Crossword Solver](https://webnotepad.github.io/crossword-solver) – Clue helper and word finder for crosswords.
- [Word Search Solver](https://webnotepad.github.io/word-search-solver) – Find hidden words in letter grids.
- [Contexto Hints](https://webnotepad.github.io/contexto-hints) – Helper for Contexto-style word games.

## Productivity & Habit Tools

- [Pomodoro Timer](https://webnotepad.github.io/pomodoro-timer) – Customizable work/break intervals with alerts.
- [Habit Tracker](https://webnotepad.github.io/habit-tracker) – Visual calendar and streak tracking.
- [Click Speed Test](https://webnotepad.github.io/click-speed-test) – Measure clicks per second.

## Calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/age-calculator) – Exact age, next birthday, zodiac, milestones.
- [BMI Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/bmi-calculator) – Body Mass Index with WHO categories.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/fuel-cost-calculator) – Trip cost from distance, efficiency and price.
- [Paint Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/paint-calculator) – Paint needed for rooms (metric/imperial).
- [Percentage Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/percentage-calculator) – Percent of, change, difference, reverse.
- [Sleep Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/sleep-calculator) – Ideal bedtime/wake times based on 90-min cycles.
- [Unit Converter](https://webnotepad.github.io/unit-converter)
- [Roof Pitch Calculator](https://webnotepad.github.io/roof-pitch-calculator)

## Hub Pages

- [All Tools](https://webnotepad.github.io/all-tools) – Complete catalog of every tool and app.

- [Blog](https://webnotepad.github.io/blog) – Articles on productivity, note-taking, privacy and tools.

## Key Principles

- 100% free forever – no accounts, no subscriptions, no paywalls.
- Privacy by default – all data stays in the browser’s local storage.
- Works offline after first load.
- No tracking of note content or game progress on servers.
- Mobile-responsive and works on modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera).
